facts.business: Niraj Cement Structurals Limited is engaged in construction and infrastructure development, executing projects through joint venture entities under its supervision and control.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on fixed assets, including capital advances

auditor.name: Chaturvedi Sohan & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (a) Turnover and costs related to joint venture entities booked in company's books; (b) DGGI search and seizure proceedings challenged in Gujarat High Court, ₹108.40 Lacs deposited under protest; (c) Balances of trade payables, receivables, advances, GST, and tax assets subject to reconciliation; (d) ₹2,769.36 lakh ECL provision made in prior year, ₹162.93 lakh recovered during year; (e) Income Tax Assets (Net) of ₹2,068.82 Lakhs pending appeal orders; (f) Audit trail (edit log) feature not activated throughout the year for all relevant transactions.
